prompts.part-measure: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original game tile icon. Image 1 is ONLY the style reference, not the subject. Match its flat cute 2D illustrated board-game token style: rounded bouncy subtly asymmetric silhouette, thick gently irregular dark-teal outline, broad matte color fields, one simple hard-edged accent shadow, very subtle sparse paper grain. Warm cream, coral, mustard and mint palette. Front or shallow three-quarter illustration, bold simple shapes recognizable at 40px. Cuteness comes from proportions and colors. Absolutely NO eyes, mouths, faces, cheeks, eyebrows, arms, hands, legs, shoes or anthropomorphism. No smooth gradients, 3D rendering, realistic material, clay, glossy reflections, ground shadow, scene, letters, numbers, watermark, border or white sticker outline. Exactly one complete isolated object centered in a square, fills about 84% canvas, with even genuinely transparent margins. Subject: a chunky rounded mustard-yellow POCKET TAPE MEASURE, dark-teal edging and a coral top lock button. A short cream measuring ribbon comes out on the lower right and makes one playful curl, with a few simple dark-teal tick marks and a small coral end hook. The large side of the yellow case is plain except for a tiny cream four-point spark decal, not a face or clock dial. The distinctive visible curling ribbon makes this instantly recognizable as a tape measure. No boots, limbs or hands.
